definitions.explanation: A social gathering of former classmates or schoolmates, typically organized years after graduation to reconnect.
A formal organization of graduates from a particular school that maintains connections among alumni.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}、{同窓会|どうそうかい}がある。
examples.english: There is a class reunion next month.

examples.japanese: {二十年|にじゅうねん}ぶりの{同窓会|どうそうかい}で{懐|なつ}かしい{顔|かお}に{再会|さいかい}した。
examples.english: I was reunited with familiar faces at the reunion after twenty years.

examples.japanese: {同窓会|どうそうかい}に{出席|しゅっせき}したら、みんなずいぶん{変|か}わっていて{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: When I attended the class reunion, I was surprised at how much everyone had changed.

examples.japanese: {同窓会|どうそうかい}の{名簿|めいぼ}を{更新|こうしん}する。
examples.english: To update the alumni association directory.

examples.japanese: {同窓会|どうそうかい}が{奨学金|しょうがくきん}を{設立|せつりつ}した。
examples.english: The alumni association established a scholarship.

examples.japanese: {同窓会|どうそうかい}の{会長|かいちょう}に{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: I was elected president of the alumni association.

notes:
COMPOSITION:
{同窓|どうそう} (same school, fellow students) + {会|かい} (meeting, association). Literally "same-window meeting," where {窓|まど} (window) represents the classroom.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同窓会|どうそうかい}に{出席|しゅっせき}する (to attend a reunion)
- {同窓会|どうそうかい}を{開|ひら}く (to hold a reunion)
- {同窓会|どうそうかい}の{幹事|かんじ} (reunion organizer)
- {同窓会|どうそうかい}の{案内|あんない} (reunion invitation)
